# Facebook Comments Scraper

The Apify actor [`apify/facebook-comments-scraper`](https://apify.com/apify/facebook-comments-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.374**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Extract data from hundreds of Facebook comments from one or multiple Facebook posts. Get comment text, timestamp, likes count and basic commenter info. Download the data in JSON, CSV, Excel and use it in apps, spreadsheets, and reports.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Comment $0.0025, Actor start $0.001, Add-on: Date filter $0.002 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/facebook-comments-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-facebook-comments-scraper@0.0.374#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      startUrls: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `startUrls` | array | yes |  | Facebook URLs — Valid facebook URL |
| `resultsLimit` | integer |  |  | Results amount — If this limit is not set as many results as possible are returned |
| `includeNestedComments` | boolean |  | `false` | Include comment replies — If checked, the actor will return up to 3 levels of comments/replies for each post. Note that each reply/comment will be returned as a separate result. |
| `viewOption` | string |  | `"RANKED_UNFILTERED"` | Comments mode — Choose the way the comments are sorted |
| `onlyCommentsNewerThan` | string |  |  | 📅 Extract comments that are newer than — Limit how far back to the history the scraper should go. The date should be in YYYY-MM-DD or full ISO absolute format or in relative format e.g. 1 year, 2 months, 3 days, 4 hours, or 5 minutes. All time values are taken in UTC timezone. ## Output

Each dataset item is typed from the actor's published dataset schema. Every field may be null, and items may carry fields beyond these.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `facebookUrl` | string \| null | URL of the Facebook post the comment belongs to. |
| `postTitle` | string \| null | Title or subject of the parent post. |
| `postDescription` | string \| null | Description or body text of the parent post. |
| `commentUrl` | string \| null | Direct URL to the comment. |
| `commentId` | string \| null | Facebook comment ID. |
| `id` | string \| null | Internal numeric ID of the comment. |
| `feedbackId` | string \| null | Facebook feedback ID associated with the comment. |
| `name` | string \| null | Display name of the comment author. |
| `date` | string \| null | Date and time the comment was posted, in ISO 8601 format. |
| `text` | string \| null | Text content of the comment. |
| `attachments` | array \| null | Media attachments included in the comment. |
| `author` | object \| null | Raw author object of the comment. |
| `profileUrl` | string \| object \| null | URL of the commenter's Facebook profile. |
| `profileId` | string \| null | Facebook profile ID of the commenter. |
| `profileName` | string \| null | Profile name of the commenter. |
| `profilePicture` | string \| null | URL of the commenter's profile picture. |
| `likesCount` | string \| null | Number of likes the comment received. |
| `commentsCount` | number \| null | Number of replies to this comment. |
| `comments` | array \| null | Nested replies to this comment. |
| `threadingDepth` | number \| null | Nesting depth of the comment (0 for top-level). |
| `replyToCommentId` | string \| null | ID of the parent comment this is a reply to. |
| `parentComment` | object \| null | Parent comment object if this is a reply. |
| `parentReply` | object \| null | Direct parent reply object if this is a nested reply. |
